# FastSpeech 2 + HiFi-GAN (SpeechBrain LJ Speech)

SpeechBrain

SpeechBrain-trained FastSpeech2 acoustic model plus its LJ Speech HiFi-GAN vocoder. Original-paper MOS is not transferred to this checkpoint. CPU run command adapted from model card; memory is an estimated 4GB runtime budget, not a local measurement.

[Model and usage documentation](https://huggingface.co/speechbrain/tts-fastspeech2-ljspeech)

[Catalogue source](https://huggingface.co/speechbrain/tts-fastspeech2-ljspeech/blob/c50d854a2b3f6be0e08b694c67a92ca56228de18/README.md)

No reviewed benchmark results yet. This catalogue entry has no score or rank.

## How to run it

```sh
uv run --with speechbrain --with soundfile python -c "import soundfile as sf; from speechbrain.inference.TTS import FastSpeech2; from speechbrain.inference.vocoders import HIFIGAN; t=FastSpeech2.from_hparams(source='speechbrain/tts-fastspeech2-ljspeech', savedir='pretrained/fastspeech2'); v=HIFIGAN.from_hparams(source='speechbrain/tts-hifigan-ljspeech', savedir='pretrained/hifigan'); mel,_,_,_=t.encode_text(['Hello world.']); wav=v.decode_batch(mel); sf.write('speech.wav', wav.squeeze().detach().cpu().numpy(), 22050)"
```
